hypotheses.justification: The charts are smooth for every real a. From the definition of positiveRadius, for ℓ < 0 its value is ≤ ℓ < 0: when x ≤ ℓ use Real.smoothTransition.nonneg; when ℓ ≤ x use Real.smoothTransition.zero_of_nonpos. Thus for a < 0 the denominator in extendedBase never vanishes, while its square-root argument is positive by positiveRadius_pos applied to a²/32. The existing smoothness proof therefore extends to a < 0. For a = 0, positiveRadius 0 x = 0, so extendedBase is constantly (0,0) and each chart is constant. Replace chart_contDiff ha with this all-a smoothness result; the compactness and finite-sum proof is unchanged. Negative b gives an empty ball and causes no exception.
